description: Configure VSCode for continuous testing workflow. You are working on a Python project located at /home/ga/workspace/data_processor with existing pytest tests. Your task is to configure VSCode so that tests run automatically whenever you save a Python file. Required configuration: (1) Enable pytest by setting 'python.testing.pytestEnabled' to true in VSCode user settings, (2) Enable automatic test discovery on save by setting 'python.testing.autoTestDiscoverOnSaveEnabled' to true, (3) Enable auto-save by setting 'files.autoSave' to 'afterDelay' so tests trigger without manual save, (4) Configure pytest arguments by setting 'python.testing.pytestArgs' to include the tests directory. You can configure these settings either through the Settings UI (Ctrl+,) by searching for each setting name, or by directly editing the settings.json file at /home/ga/.config/Code/User/settings.json. The workspace contains src/validator.py with validation functions and tests/test_validator.py with pytest tests. After configuration, verify the setup works by opening the Testing panel (beaker icon in sidebar) to see discovered tests.
